title: RTX's Pratt & Whitney completes successful demonstration test of 3D-printed TJ150 engine
summary: Additive manufacturing increases production speed and industrial flexibility to meet growing demand for expendable engines LONDON, July 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Farnborough International Airshow– Pratt & Whitney, an RTX (NYSE: RTX) business, announced the successful completion of demonstration testing for its additively manufactured TJ150 engine. Nearly 60% of the engine by volume was produced through additive manufacturing, including major static and rotating hardware. The testing focused on validating material behavior in an operational environment and demonstrating durability aligned with mission demands.
